from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1'
if (OUT/'result.json').exists(): raise RuntimeError('纠错结果已经存在，禁止重跑。')
def now(): return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def clean(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict): return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)): return [clean(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x,(datetime,pd.Timestamp)): return x.isoformat()
    if isinstance(x,(np.integer,np.floating,np.bool_)): return clean(x.item())
    if isinstance(x,float) and not math.isfinite(x): return None
    return x
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    if p.exists(): raise RuntimeError('禁止覆盖已保存研究结果：'+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(clean(obj),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

def tree_values(x,spec):
    xf=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float32)
    left=np.asarray(spec['tree_children_left'],int)
    right=np.asarray(spec['tree_children_right'],int)
    feature=np.asarray(spec['tree_feature'],int)
    threshold=np.asarray(spec['tree_threshold'],float)
    value=np.asarray(spec['tree_value'],float)
    nodes=np.zeros(len(xf),dtype=int)
    for step in range(4):
        active=left[nodes]>=0
        if not active.any(): return value[nodes]
        rows=np.flatnonzero(active)
        at=nodes[rows]
        cond=xf[rows,feature[at]]<=threshold[at]
        nodes[rows]=np.where(cond,left[at],right[at])
    assert (left[nodes]<0).all()
    return value[nodes]

with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
    for ordinal, old in enumerate(base8.itertuples(index=False),1):
        i=int(old.idx)
        masks={}
        for size,d in [(8,d8),(10,d10)]:
            valid=d.valid_features if size==8 else d.valid_ten_features
            masks[size]=(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&valid&d.net_label.notna()
        assert masks[8].equals(masks[10])
        pool_idx=np.flatnonzero(masks[8].to_numpy())
        assert len(pool_idx)==old.n_train and int(d8.exit_idx.iloc[pool_idx].max())==old.max_label_exit_idx
        assert (d8.exit_idx.iloc[pool_idx]<=i).all()
        training.append({'idx':i,'date':old.date,'training_indices':pool_idx.tolist(),'max_label_exit_idx':int(old.max_label_exit_idx)})
        y=d8.net_label.iloc[pool_idx].to_numpy(float)
        assert abs(float(y.mean())-old.mean_prediction)<1e-12
        assert abs(float(d8.net_label.iloc[i])-old.actual_net5)<1e-12
        for size,d,F in [(8,d8,F8),(10,d10,F10)]:
            x=d.iloc[pool_idx][F].to_numpy(float)
            current=d.loc[i,F].to_numpy(float).reshape(1,-1)
            model=DecisionTreeRegressor(**{k:protocol['model'][k] for k in ['max_depth','min_samples_leaf','random_state']}).fit(x,y)
            prediction=float(model.predict(current)[0])
            fitted=model.predict(x)
            score=float(100*((fitted<prediction).mean()+.5*(fitted==prediction).mean()))
            mean,scale=x.mean(axis=0),x.std(axis=0,ddof=1)
            scale[scale<1e-12]=1.
            z=np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-5,5)
            zmean=z.mean(axis=0)
            centered=z-zmean
            coefficients=np.linalg.solve(centered.T@centered+10*np.eye(len(F)),centered.T@(y-y.mean()))
            linear=float(y.mean()+(np.clip((current[0]-mean)/scale,-5,5)-zmean)@coefficients)
            tree=model.tree_
            spec={'idx':i,'date':old.date,'n_train':len(pool_idx),'training_label_max_idx':int(old.max_label_exit_idx),'features_used':[F[j] for j in sorted(set(tree.feature[tree.feature>=0]))],'leaves':int(model.get_n_leaves()),'tree_children_left':tree.children_left.tolist(),'tree_children_right':tree.children_right.tolist(),'tree_feature':tree.feature.tolist(),'tree_threshold':tree.threshold.tolist(),'tree_value':tree.value.ravel().tolist(),'tree_samples':tree.n_node_samples.tolist(),'linear_coefficients':coefficients.tolist(),'linear_mean':mean.tolist(),'linear_scale':scale.tolist(),'linear_zmean':zmean.tolist(),'linear_target_mean':float(y.mean())}
            # 必要检查：保存树必须能复算当日预测和训练排名，使用原树的float32分支口径。
            recovered=tree_values(np.vstack([current,x]),spec)
            assert np.allclose(recovered[1:],fitted,rtol=0,atol=1e-14)
            assert abs(float(recovered[0])-prediction)<1e-14
            recovered_score=float(100*((recovered[1:]<recovered[0]).mean()+.5*(recovered[1:]==recovered[0]).mean()))
            assert abs(recovered_score-score)<1e-12
            row={'idx':i,'date':old.date,'era':old.era,'n_train':len(pool_idx),'max_label_exit_idx':int(old.max_label_exit_idx),'score':score,'score_bin':min(int(score//20),4),'nonlinear_prediction':prediction,'linear_prediction':linear,'mean_prediction':float(y.mean()),'actual_net5':float(d.net_label.iloc[i]),'historical_only':True}
            if size==10:
                row.update({'base_score':predictions[8][-1]['score'],'base_nonlinear_prediction':predictions[8][-1]['nonlinear_prediction'],'base_linear_prediction':predictions[8][-1]['linear_prediction'],'rate_change20':float(d.loc[i,F10[8]]),'funding_gap_change20':float(d.loc[i,F10[9]]),'observed_rate_regime':d.loc[i,'observed_rate_regime'],'funding_gap_regime':d.loc[i,'funding_gap_regime'],'new_feature_used_in_tree':any(c in spec['features_used'] for c in F10[8:])})
            predictions[size].append(row)
            fits[size].append(spec)
        if ordinal%400==0: print('同参数纠错评分已完成：'+str(ordinal)+'/1212日。',flush=True)

def summarize(values):
    v=pd.Series(values,dtype=float).dropna()
    win=v[v>0];loss=v[v<0]
    return {'n':len(v),'mean_net5':float(v.mean()),'median_net5':float(v.median()),'win_rate':float((v>0).mean()) if len(v) else None,'return_payoff':float(win.mean()/-loss.mean()) if len(win) and len(loss) else None}
buckets=[];errors=[];events=[];annual=[];pair_changes=[]

        family=version+str(size)+'变量'
        next_decision=-1

        for row in rows.itertuples(index=False):
            if row.idx<next_decision or row.score<80 or row.nonlinear_prediction<=0 or not np.isfinite(row.actual_net5): continue
            event={'model':family,'version':version,'features':size,'era':row.era,'signal_idx':int(row.idx),'signal_date':row.date,'entry_date':d8.date.iloc[row.idx+1],'exit_date':d8.date.iloc[row.idx+6],'score':float(row.score),'prediction':float(row.nonlinear_prediction),'net_event_return':float(row.actual_net5)}
            selected.append(event);events.append(event)

        for era,block in rows.groupby('era',sort=False):

                buckets.append({'model':family,'era':era,'score_band':str(20*band)+'—'+str(20*(band+1)),**summarize(block.loc[mask,'actual_net5'])})
            for model in ['mean','linear','nonlinear']:

        for year in range(2021,2026):

            annual.append({'model':family,'year':year,**summarize(vals)})
